architecture: Joint error-state EKF with full state/landmark covariance; raw full-aperture or two-top-corner factors, public gyro and20Hz body specific-force factors, own-command dynamics, gyro/model bias states. Nominal gate1.5m mean is fixed; size/rim uncertainty remains coupled. Late camera factors replay all later motion and measurement events.
inputs: Camera pixels, public IMU samples/timestamps/receipts and our own commands. No native navigation or training labels.
boundary: Reference files enter the scorer only. The replay schema rejects additional fields. Accepted pixel export is invariant to previous p/v/R values. Live normal/poisoned replays match.

protocol.scope: Three prospective unchanged repetitions with nominal aperture mean fixed1.5m and size uncertainty carried as a consider parameter. Startup completion has priority on the deadline tick; all thresholds unchanged. Earlier prototype flights retained separately. Speed2m/s, brake trigger10m.

protocol.method: Joint p/v/attitude/gyro-bias/force-bias, nominal aperture size, rim dimensions and upright gate xyz/yaw EKF;1s rewind and full event replay. Body specific-force observations at20Hz, without acceleration preintegration.
protocol.association: Frozen accepted pixel tracks and own mission IDs. Previous estimated p/v/R are excluded. Availability is conservative send-return time; NIS may reject tracks.
protocol.timing: Public timestamp epochs and receipts; published elapsed time is not exact force preintegration. Command epoch uses the preceding public receipt-offset envelope.
protocol.binding: Three distinct, consistent images can bind a5m-nearer landmark after innovation rejection. The old landmark stays separate; no native identity labels.

noise.gyro: Stationary measured density or0.001 floor, plus per-interval angular-rate variation uncertainty.
noise.rim: Two shared dimension states; public P90-P10 spread supplies prior uncertainty.
noise.acceleration_timing: Instantaneous body force; uncertainty grows with recent own-command changes.

alignment.note: Same fixed initial heading gauge as the recorded baseline; origin at first shared scorer epoch. No fit to tested attitude.

score.native_used_for: Scoring only; no outputs returned to replay
score.comparison: Same recorded commands and camera candidates; this replay cannot establish closed-loop flight performance.

offline_attempts.qualification: Frozen public accepted tracks; source flights previously inspected. Regression comparison, not a fresh flight.

protocol.timing: Public timestamp epochs and receipts; published elapsed time is not exact force preintegration. Command epoch uses the preceding public receipt-offset envelope.
protocol.binding: Three distinct, consistent images can bind a5m-nearer landmark after innovation rejection. The old landmark stays separate; no native identity labels.

noise.gyro: Stationary measured density or0.001 floor, plus per-interval angular-rate variation uncertainty.
noise.rim: Two shared dimension states; public P90-P10 spread supplies prior uncertainty.
noise.acceleration_timing: Instantaneous body force; uncertainty grows with recent own-command changes.

alignment.note: Same fixed initial heading gauge as the recorded baseline; origin at first shared scorer epoch. No fit to tested attitude.

score.native_used_for: Scoring only; no outputs returned to replay
score.comparison: Same recorded commands and camera candidates; this replay cannot establish closed-loop flight performance.

offline_attempts.qualification: Frozen public accepted tracks; source flights previously inspected. Regression comparison, not a fresh flight.

native_reference_independence.mode: Accepted public tracks, dynamic accelerometer factors and fixed nominal size. Every posterior mean and covariance array is unchanged.

ablation: --no-force disables dynamic accelerometer factors with the same public initialization, commands and pixel tracks. It is recorded separately; sensor acceleration still initializes gravity.
fixes: Replaced independent delayed p/v/tilt corrections with one joint posterior and complete replay.
Separated rejected pixel candidates from accepted tracks in the replay input.
Confirmed nearer visual landmarks over three distinct images; mission ordinal does not force one permanent landmark.
Added instantaneous accelerometer factors instead of assuming exact sensor preintegration intervals.
Kept known nominal size fixed instead of fitting away motion/model error.
Checked successful settling before the deadline error on the same control tick.
limits: One slow gate has live validation; six gates below10s remains unsolved.
The0.3m/s braking velocity RMS target remains unmet in the final native cohort.
Longer recorded flights still have position/attitude drift and uneven covariance coverage.
The planner uses mean-state constraints; it does not yet optimize visibility and posterior crossing probability.
True exposure time and actual IMU physics integration intervals remain unknown; timestamps use public alignment.
next: Two gates back to back with joint feedback, then use relative covariance and predicted visibility in the crossing trajectory.
